Question Choices: Which statement is always true of a rectangle? (A) All sides are equal (B) Opposite sides are equal (C) No sides are equal
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Choose B. Opposite sides of every rectangle are equal. All four sides are equal only for the special case of a square.

Question Choices: Select. Is every square also a rhombus? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Yes. A square has four equal sides, satisfying the definition of a rhombus.

Question Choices: If two opposite sides of a shape are parallel and the other two are also parallel, what shape could it be?
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: The shape is a parallelogram; a rectangle, rhombus or square is also possible because each has two pairs of parallel opposite sides.

Question Choices: Select. Is a rhombus also a parallelogram? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Yes. Every rhombus has two pairs of parallel opposite sides and is therefore a parallelogram.

Question Choices: A shape has 4 sides and all angles are 90 degrees. What shape could it be?
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Four sides and four right angles define a rectangle. If all four sides are also equal, it is a square.
